answer: Divergent-path registration: each identity must publish a per-epoch trajectory shaped by a hidden prompt drawn from a shared karst-like seed pool, and agents verify mutual divergence; clones replaying one path collide and get flagged. A sybil farm must run genuinely distinct policy instances, paying full compute and orchestration cost per identity rather than copying one. Verification happens on a public terrace of logged checkpoints, so any whisper of path reuse is detectable.
